# Neuctra UI

> Neuctra UI is a developer toolkit with a React component library, project setup CLI, and MCP integrations that give compatible AI coding assistants structured UI knowledge. This file indexes the documentation site.

Docs home: https://ui.neuctra.com/docs
Full setup guide: https://ui.neuctra.com/docs/full-setup
MCP server (AI tool integration): https://ui.neuctra.com/docs/mcp
AI assistant overview: https://ui.neuctra.com/docs/ai-assistant
Remote MCP over HTTP: https://ui.neuctra.com/docs/mcp-http
Neuctra UI CLI: https://ui.neuctra.com/docs/cli
Blog: https://ui.neuctra.com/blog
Disclaimer: https://ui.neuctra.com/disclaimer
